purpose: Intended chatbot behaviour for questions in the clinician question bank, keyed by question ID. Used by scripts/run_question_bank.py. Holds no question text and no individual data; the question bank itself is private. Questions without an entry get the general checks only. 'refusal': expected | not_expected | either (the portal's fixed medical-advice refusal). Phrase matches are case-insensitive.
